title: The Spiral Mark/Quotes
summary:
"In the ages to come, without a common enemy many Seekers will turn to evil."
- Lord Casterwill to his children

"You can do better. My audience will be disappointed." (Rassimov)

"They'll only be disappointed when you lose." (Dante Vale)

"Impossible. Legion cannot be defeated." (Rassimov)

"It can, and so can you." (Dante Vale)

"I'll have you know, Montehue, that before you joined the Huntik Foundation, rescuing Dante was my job."
- Metz to Montehue

"Unlimited power, it will be mine. Vow to might. Red Comet, I command you! Uh? What? What is happening?!"
-Rassimov's last words before being vaporized by the Red Comet

"But Umbra doesn't have enough power to bring you there and back!" (Sophie Casterwill)

"I'm afraid this is a one way trip." (Dante Vale)

"Sophie, take care of Lok. Make sure he grows up just like his father."
-Dante Vale to Sophie Casterwill

"It is hopeless. Your very fate has been designed, by me. (The Betrayer)

"I already know my future. Arc the Legendary Titan of Fate showed it to me. It is not a happy ending for me, but at least in my future, you lose! (Dante Vale)
